svg.title: Newsletter Agent Architecture
svg.desc: Multi-step agentic flow: goal input → planner → research → summarizer → writer → critic → output

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the goal input step do?')
sendPrompt('What does the Planner step do in the newsletter agent?')
sendPrompt('How does the research tool work?')
sendPrompt('How does the summarizer tool work?')
sendPrompt('What does the HTML generator tool do?')
sendPrompt('What is the self-reflection / critique step?')
sendPrompt('How does the Human-in-the-Loop gate work?')
sendPrompt('How is the newsletter output saved?')

svg.text: Single entry point — entire pipeline in one call
